submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 6 mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution (3.09% at 100 GeV) among the candidates, fulfilling the main goal. All project constraints are met: the plate thickness is within the allowed 2-10 mm range; mechanical, readout, and cooling systems are compatible; and hands-on maintenance is supported. Prior and current simulations confirm stability of the result. Thus, this option optimally balances performance and requirements.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three listed absorbers.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: All options are compatible with hands-on maintenance (meeting_notes_2026-05-14.md, candidate_specs.md).
Chosen plate thickness is 6 mm, within specified limits.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulations show Absorber-F2 at 6 mm achieves 3.09% energy resolution, the best among all candidates.
